rule: GEO honesty rule: no invented stats/numbers. Every article must open with a direct answer in the first ~100 words, use real question-shaped H2s, include a short-answer FAQ section with Organization+Article+FAQPage JSON-LD, and only claim features NutraScan actually has (cross-check against project_nutrascan.md memory before writing if unsure). Reuse an existing /assets/*.jpg for og:image/hero, never invent a new image.
